steps.title: Choose a detector setup
steps.text: Select a saved detector setup; its logical detector/excitation channels are offered below.

steps.title: Add a pair
steps.text: Choose A and B. Identical channels make ACF; different channels make CCF. Add a unique pair name.

steps.title: Edit correlator options
steps.text: Select the pair row. Leave bins/cascades blank or Fine at Default to inherit global settings.

steps.title: Save and apply
steps.text: Save validated definitions. Apply also notifies a connected correlator; import/export retain the library.
